text: Plan a couple's trip to Japan, fly into Tokyo and out of Osaka, 2026-12-01 to 2026-12-06, 2 people
draft:
I'll start by loading the city skills and searching hotels for both bases.# Japan draft itinerary — Tokyo in, Osaka out (1–6 Dec 2026)

**Overview**: Tokyo 3 nights → Osaka 2 nights → leave from Kansai Airport | 1 hotel change | light · standard · standard · standard · tiring · light

Kyoto and Nara are covered as day trips from Osaka, so you only change hotels once. Early December is quiet and cool (roughly 5–15 °C, approx.), with autumn leaves mostly finished and winter illuminations starting — good walking weather, but check forecasts before each day.

**Before you go**
- Book timed-entry or reservation-only places a few weeks ahead: Shibuya Sky or an observation deck at sunset, teamLab (if you want it), and any Kyoto temple that requires advance booking (e.g. Katsura Imperial Villa, Saiho-ji) — please check availability.
- Get an IC card (Suica/PASMO/ICOCA) at the airport; it works on trains, subways and buses in all three cities.
- Reserve Shinkansen seats (Tokyo → Shin-Osaka) a few days ahead for two people together.
- On 4 Dec, forward your luggage from the Tokyo hotel to the Osaka hotel by takkyubin (send it the evening of 3 Dec) and travel with a small bag.
- A JR Pass is not worth it for this route — compare current prices if you plan extra long legs.
- Check each temple's and museum's opening days/hours before going; many close around 16:30–17:00 and some museums close on Mondays.

**Day 1 | Arrival · Asakusa / Ueno (light)**
- 14:00 Narita Airport → Keisei Skyliner to Ueno, approx. 45 min, no transfer (if you land at Haneda: Keikyu Line to Shinagawa, approx. 20 min)
- 15:30 Check in near Shimbashi/Shiodome, rest
- 17:00 Senso-ji and Nakamise, Asakusa (Ginza Line to Asakusa, approx. 20 min, no transfer): lit up in the evening and far quieter than by day
- 19:00 Dinner in Asakusa, early night
- Tonight: Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai (三井花园酒店汐留意大利街)

**Day 2 | Shibuya · Harajuku · Shinjuku (standard)**
- 08:30 Meiji Jingu (JR to Harajuku, approx. 25 min, 1 transfer): calmest early morning
- 10:30 Takeshita Street and Omotesando, walk approx. 15 min between them
- 12:30 Lunch in Omotesando
- 14:30 Shibuya Crossing and Shibuya Sky (Ginza Line 1 stop, approx. 3 min): late-afternoon slot for the view
- 17:30 Shinjuku (JR Yamanote, approx. 7 min, no transfer): Omoide Yokocho and Golden Gai for dinner
- Alternatives: if rain, Tokyo National Museum or a department-store food hall in Shibuya instead of the Omotesando walk; if tired, drop Shibuya Sky and keep the crossing only
- Tonight: Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai (三井花园酒店汐留意大利街)

**Day 3 | Ginza · Tsukiji · Imperial Palace (standard)**
- 08:00 Tsukiji Outer Market for breakfast (walk approx. 15 min from the hotel): best before 10:00
- 10:30 Imperial Palace East Gardens (walk approx. 15 min)
- 12:30 Lunch in Marunouchi
- 14:00 Ginza browsing and a café break (walk approx. 15 min)
- 17:00 Back to the hotel to pack; send luggage to Osaka tonight
- 19:00 Dinner near Shimbashi
- Alternatives: if rain, Ginza's department stores and the Mitsui Memorial Museum instead of the East Gardens; if tired, drop Ginza and rest before dinner
- Tonight: Mitsui Garden Hotel Shiodome Italia-gai (三井花园酒店汐留意大利街)

**Day 4 | Tokyo → Osaka · Minami (standard)**
- 09:00 Hotel → Tokyo Station (JR, approx. 10 min, no transfer), then Tokaido Shinkansen Nozomi to Shin-Osaka, approx. 2 h 30 min
- 12:00 Shin-Osaka → Namba (Midosuji Line, approx. 15 min, no transfer), check in and lunch
- 14:30 Kuromon Market and Shinsaibashi, walk approx. 15 min
- 17:30 Dotonbori at dusk: neon and street food, best after dark
- Alternatives: if rain, the Namba/Shinsaibashi covered arcades and a long lunch instead of Kuromon; if tired, skip Shinsaibashi and go straight to Dotonbori
- Tonight: Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka Namba (相铁Grand Fresa 大阪难波酒店)

**Day 5 | Kyoto day trip · Higashiyama (tiring)**
- 07:30 Namba → Kyoto (Midosuji to Umeda, then JR Special Rapid, approx. 50 min total, 1 transfer)
- 09:00 Kiyomizu-dera, then walk downhill through Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka, approx. 20 min
- 11:30 Yasaka Shrine and Gion lanes
- 12:30 Lunch near Kawaramachi
- 14:00 Nishiki Market, walk approx. 15 min
- 16:00 Kyoto Station → Namba, approx. 50 min, 1 transfer; dinner in Osaka
- Alternatives: if rain, Kyoto National Museum or the Nishiki arcade instead of the Sannenzaka walk; if tired, drop Nishiki Market and return after Gion
- Tonight: Sotetsu Grand Fresa Osaka Namba (相铁Grand Fresa 大阪难波酒店)

**Day 6 | Departure (light)**
- 08:30 Breakfast and a short walk near the hotel only
- 10:30 Namba → Kansai Airport by Nankai rapi:t, approx. 40 min, no transfer; leave plenty of time for check-in
- If your flight is late, Nara Park is a possible morning add-on (Kintetsu from Osaka-Namba, approx. 40 min) — please check your flight time first

All times are approximate; please confirm train times, opening hours and reservations before you go.
